When a foundation build helps

Your website should be doing more than simply existing.

A Website & Digital Foundation Build is designed for businesses that need a credible, working customer journey online before they invest further in marketing, automation or connected systems.

01 →

Your website is outdated, slow or difficult to update.

02 →

Visitors arrive, but very few of them enquire.

03 →

Enquiries land somewhere nobody checks quickly.

04 →

Nobody can say which pages or campaigns actually produce customers.

What we can build

Every Foundation Build is scoped around your priorities.

Depending on your business, the project may include a new website or a redesign, a clearer content structure, lead capture and routing, analytics and practical team handover.

01 →

Website or redesign

A new website or a rebuild of the current one, designed around the outcome that matters: credibility, enquiries, bookings or sales.

02 →

Page structure and content direction

Core pages organised so a visitor understands the offer, the proof and the next step without having to hunt for them.

03 →

Landing pages and enquiry forms

Campaign pages, enquiry forms and clear calls to action placed where people are actually ready to act.

04 →

Lead connections

Enquiries routed into WhatsApp, email, a calendar or a CRM, so a new lead reaches a person rather than an unread inbox.

05 →

Analytics and conversion tracking

Basic measurement, so you can see which pages, sources and campaigns produce real enquiries.

06 →

Mobile, usability and performance

A site that loads quickly and works properly on the phones most of your visitors are actually using.

The exact scope is confirmed after a consultation and written proposal. You will not be asked to pay for work your business does not need.

How the build works

A clear process, with no guesswork.

We make the work practical, transparent and easy to understand before and during delivery.

01

Consultation and discovery

We learn how your business wins customers, review the current website and enquiry path, and identify where interest is being lost.

02

Written scope and proposal

You receive a clear list of deliverables, responsibilities, timeline, investment and any third-party software or subscription costs.

03

Access and materials

You provide the access, content, brand assets and business context needed, and we confirm who owns the domain and platform accounts.

04

Build and review

We design and build the agreed work, share progress at sensible points and request decisions where they affect the outcome.

05

Testing, training and handover

We test the site and the enquiry path with you, explain what has changed, train the people who will use it and hand over the agreed accounts and documentation.

06

Optional monthly partnership

If you want the website, customer journey and connected tools improved every month afterwards, we can recommend the appropriate partnership tier. There is no obligation to continue.

What to have ready

You do not need everything organised before we talk.

But these items help us scope the work faster and avoid unnecessary questions.

  • 01Your website address and business contact details.
  • 02A short explanation of the outcome you want: more enquiries, more bookings, a clearer offer or a better-looking business.
  • 03Domain, hosting and website-provider details, if available.
  • 04Where enquiries should go: WhatsApp, an inbox, a calendar or a CRM.
  • 05Existing content, photographs, product information and logo files, where relevant.
  • 06Examples of websites you like, and what you like about them.
  • 07A person in your business who can approve decisions and provide access.
Investment

Website & Digital Foundation Builds start from GHS 15,000.

The final price depends on the number of pages, the amount of content and design work required, the lead connections involved and whether an existing site is being improved or replaced.

After the consultation, you will receive a written proposal before any work begins. Larger builds that also include a CRM, integrations and automation are scoped as a Connected Growth System Build.

Frequently asked questions

Straight answers before you start.

How long does a Foundation Build take?+

Most projects are completed over a defined timeline agreed in the proposal. Timing depends on the scope, access to the existing site and how quickly content and approvals are provided.

Do we need a monthly partnership afterwards?+

No. A Foundation Build is a standalone project. A monthly partnership is available if you want Dakyworld to keep improving the website, customer journey and connected tools after handover.

Will we own our website, accounts and data?+

Yes. Your business retains ownership of its domain, platform accounts, source files and data. Dakyworld works through controlled access and documents what has been set up.

Can you work with our existing website?+

Usually, yes. The consultation determines whether the current site can be improved, needs restructuring or should be replaced.

What is not included?+

The proposal states exactly what is included and excluded. Third-party software, subscriptions, hosting, domains, paid plugins, stock imagery and platform fees are normally billed separately unless stated otherwise.
